position: absolute; inset: 0; display: block; padding: calc(var(--cw) * 0.06) calc(var(--cw) * 0.06) calc(var(--cw) * 0.2); background: var(--cover) 0 0 / 100% 100%, var(--tx-leather) 0 0 / calc(var(--bp) * 8) calc(var(--bp) * 8), var(--lc); box-shadow: var(--cone-drop, 0 12px 18px -8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55)); transition: box-shadow 0.4s ease;}.ab-cone-face { transform: translateZ(6px); }/* 抽出来以后：投影更远更深（落在被盖住的邻居上） */.ab-cone:hover .ab-cone-face,.ab-cone:focus-visible .ab-cone-face { --cone-drop: 14px 20px 26px -6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); transition-delay: 0.2s;}/* 附魔书（5）：一道紫色流光隔一会儿扫过封面和书脊（lightbox 里放大的那本也是） */.ab-rank-5 .ab-cone-face::after,.ab-rank-5 .ab-cone-spine::after,.about-lightbox.is-cone[data-rank='5'] .about-lightbox-tilt::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(110deg, transparent 30%, rgba(168, 102, 255, 0.36) 40%, rgba(214, 178, 255, 0.24) 46%, transparent 56%) 0 0 / 250% 100% no-repeat; animation: ab-glint 5s linear infinite; pointer-events: none;}@keyframes ab-glint { from { background-position: 150% 0; } to { background-position: -50% 0; }}.ab-cone-art { position: relative; display: block; aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; overflow: hidden; background: #2a2633;}/* 照片外圈：MC 地图的边——一圈棕、一圈羊皮纸 */.ab-cone-art::after,.about-lightbox.is-cone .about-lightbox-photo::after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 var(--bp) #8a7454, inset 0 0 0 calc(var(--bp) * 2) #efdfbf; pointer-events: none;}.ab-cone-art img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; pointer-events: none; -webkit-user-drag: none; transform: translate(calc(var(--px) * -4.5%), calc(var(--py) * -4.5%)) scale(1.14); transition: transform 0.45s ease-out;}.ab-cone-foot { position: absolute; left: calc(var(--cw) * 0.07); right: calc(var(--cw) * 0.07); bottom: 0; height: calc(var(--cw) * 0.2); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; font-family: var(--ab-mono); white-space: nowrap;}/* MC 字的样子：浅色字 + 往右下错一格的深色影子 */.ab-cone-date { font-size: calc(var(--cw) * 0.07); letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #efe4cc; text-shadow: calc(var(--bp) * 0.5) calc(var(--bp) * 0.5) 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);}/* 书脊：左侧面（绕左边缘转 −90°，厚 12px = 四个像素：暗边、亮棱、底色、暗边）， 上下各一道带子（--band），竖排标题 + 编号 + 稀有度宝石 */.ab-cone-spine { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 0; width: 12px; height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 10px 0 12px; overflow: hidden; color: #f3e7cf; background: linear-gradient(transparent 3px, var(--band) 3px 6px, transparent 6px calc(100% - 6px), var(--band) calc(100% - 6px) calc(100% - 3px), transparent calc(100% - 3px)), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5) 3px, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14) 3px 6px, transparent 6px 9px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3) 9px), var(--tx-leather) 0 0 / 24px 24px, var(--lc); transform-origin: 0 50%; transform: translateZ(-6px) rotateY(-90deg);}.ab-cone-no { font: 700 7px/1 var(--ab-mono); color: rgb(var(--rk)); text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6); }.ab-cone-title { flex: 1; margin: 6px 0; overflow: hidden; writing-mode: vertical-rl; font-family: var(--ab-hand); font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.12em; white-space: nowrap; text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);}.ab-cone-foot .ab-cone-gem { width: calc(var(--bp) * 1.5); height: calc(var(--bp) * 1.5); }/* 宝石：方方正正的一小块稀有度色，带一圈深色描边 */.ab-cone-gem { flex: none; width: 4px; height: 4px; background: rgb(var(--rk)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);}/* 胶片日期戳：琥珀色等宽 + 微光 */.about-memoir-date { position: absolute; right: 7%; bottom: 6%; font-family: var(--ab-mono); font-size: clamp(0.6rem, calc(var(--w) * 0.05), 0.78rem); font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #ffa845; text-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(255, 150, 40, 0.9), 0 0 1px rgba(90, 40, 0, 0.9);}/* --- 回忆录 lightbox（聚焦场景：暖暗背景） --- */.about-lightbox { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 40; display: none;}.about-lightbox.is-open { display: block; }.about-lightbox-backdrop { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(35, 26, 20, 0.84); backdrop-filter: blur(6px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(6px);}/* 照片：中间偏右；垂直居中用 margin 而非 transform（transform 留给取出动画）。 竖版：宽 --lw，高 = 宽 × 1.4333（留白 6%/6%/20%，照片 3:4）； 横版：宽 --lw，高 = 宽 × 0.8675（留白 4.5%/4.5%/14%，照片 4:3）——与拼贴板上的卡片同比例，取出动画不变形 */.about-lightbox-card { --lw: min(28vw, 380px); --lpad: 0.06; --lfoot: 0.2; --lratio: 1.4333; position: absolute; top: 50%; right: 9vw; width: var(--lw); margin-top: calc(var(--lw) * var(--lratio) / -2); transform-origin: top left; perspective: 950px;}.about-lightbox.is-landscape .about-lightbox-card { --lw: min(44vw, 580px); --lpad: 0.045; --lfoot: 0.14; --lratio: 0.8675;}.about-lightbox-tilt { position: relative; padding: calc(var(--lw) * var(--lpad)) calc(var(--lw) * var(--lpad)) calc(var(--lw) * var(--lfoot)); overflow: hidden; border-radius: 4px; background: var(--ab-grain-paper), var(--ab-paper); box-shadow: 0 34px 90px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55); transition: transform 0.18s ease-out; will-change: transform;}.about-lightbox-photo { position: relative; display: block; aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; overflow: hidden; background: #d9ccb8;}.about-lightbox.is-landscape .about-lightbox-photo { aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; }.about-lightbox-photo img { display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover;}.about-lightbox-cap { position: absolute; left: calc(var(--lw) * var(--lpad)); right: calc(var(--lw) * var(--lpad)); bottom: 0; height: calc(var(--lw) * var(--lfoot)); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden; font-family: var(--ab-hand); font-size: clamp(1rem, 1.7vw, 1.45rem); color: var(--ab-ink); white-space: nowrap;}.about-lightbox-photo .about-memoir-date { font-size: clamp(0.72rem, 1.1vw, 0.95rem); }/* 微弱反光：随倾斜角度移动/增亮（JS 控制透明度与位移） */.about-lightbox-glare { position: absolute; inset: -20%; background: linear-gradient(105deg, transparent 42%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35) 50%, transparent 58%); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; transition: opacity 0.2s ease;}/* 文字：中间偏左 */.about-lightbox-text { position: absolute; left: 9vw; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); width: min(36vw, 520px);}.about-lightbox-text .about-typewriter-lines { font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.2vw, 1.7rem);}.about-lightbox-close { position: absolute; top: 22px; right: 28px; width: 44px; height: 44px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1); color: var(--ab-on-img); font-size: 22px; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; backdrop-filter: blur(8px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(8px); transition: background 0.25s ease;}.about-lightbox-close:hover { background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2); }/* 从书架上的书打开：同一张封面放大（书皮底色 --lc、稀有度色 --rk、书的种类 data-rank 由 JS 从那本书上抄过来）； 标题照 MC 物品名的样子：稀有度色 + 深色影子，前面一颗方宝石 */.about-lightbox.is-cone { --cover: var(--tx-cover-3); }.about-lightbox.is-cone[data-rank='4'] { --cover: var(--tx-cover-4); }.about-lightbox.is-cone[data-rank='5'] { --cover: var(--tx-cover-5); }.about-lightbox.is-cone .about-lightbox-card { --bp: calc(var(--lw) / 32); }.about-lightbox.is-cone .about-lightbox-tilt { border-radius: 0; background: var(--cover) 0 0 / 100% 100%, var(--tx-leather) 0 0 / calc(var(--bp) * 8) calc(var(--bp) * 8), var(--lc); box-shadow: 0 34px 90px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);}.about-lightbox.is-cone .about-lightbox-photo { border-radius: 0; box-shadow: none; }.about-lightbox.is-cone .about-lightbox-cap { justify-content: flex-start; gap: 12px; color: rgb(var(--rk)); text-shadow: calc(var(--bp) * 0.35) calc(var(--bp) * 0.35) 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);}.about-lightbox.is-cone .about-lightbox-cap::before { content: ''; flex: none; width: calc(var(--bp) * 1.5); height: calc(var(--bp) * 1.5); background: rgb(var(--rk)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55);}/* ========== 分割段 ========== *//* 页面内容层需盖过全屏遮罩板(z2)与嵌入图(z1) */main#about-page { position: relative; z-index: 3;}/* 动画模式下分割段是零高占位——分割线就是相邻两块的接缝， 两块的呼吸间距由块自身的上下 padding 提供 */.about-split { position: relative; }html.ab-anim .about-split { height: 0; }/* 嵌入图：降级时是静态图带；动画模式下为全屏固定层（JS 移到 body 下） */.about-split-media { position: relative; height: 62vh;}/* 锁着（html.ab-locked）：分割段的嵌入图、遮罩板整个不显示（动画模式下钉住时长也是 0，见 about.js initLock） */html.ab-locked .about-split,html.ab-locked .about-split-media,html.ab-locked .about-panel { display: none !important; }html.ab-anim .about-split-media { position: fixed; inset: 0; height: auto; z-index: 1; opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; pointer-events: none;}.about-split-media img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block;}/* 展开时的缩放交给合成器（显卡；大图每帧重绘会卡） */html.ab-anim .about-split-media img { will-change: transform; }/* is-band（index.pug 给了取景 pos 的分割段）：动画模式下上下两块只各让开 25vh，露出来的就是屏幕中间一半—— 图只铺在这一半里（按这一条的宽高比 cover），object-position 选图上哪一段落进来；降级模式的静态图带照旧 */html.ab-anim .about-split-media.is-band img { position: absolute; left: 0; top: 25%; height: 50%;}.about-split-media-shade { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: rgba(24, 16, 10, 0.3);}.about-split-text { position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -50%); width: min(80vw, 760px); text-align: center; z-index: 2;}.about-split-text .about-typewriter-lines { font-size: clamp(1.3rem, 2.6vw, 2rem);}/* 文字靠左（图的主体在正中偏右时）：左半边、左对齐 */.about-split-text.is-left { left: 7vw; width: min(44vw, 640px); transform: translate(0, -50%); text-align: left;}/* 全屏遮罩板：与背景层同色同光，闭合时不可见；分离时上下滑开露出嵌入图 */.about-panel { position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 2; background: var(--ab-bg); opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; pointer-events: none;}/* 遮罩板复刻背景层的光晕：上板原点≈视口顶，下板原点在 50vh，所以光晕 y 坐标减 50vh */.about-panel-top { top: -2px; height: calc(50vh + 2px); background: var(--ab-grain), radial-gradient(70vw 60vh at 12vw calc(6vh + 2px), var(--ab-glow-a), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(60vw 55vh at 92vw calc(88vh + 2px), var(--ab-glow-b), transparent 70%), var(--ab-bg);}.about-panel-bottom { top: 50%; height: 52vh; background: var(--ab-grain), radial-gradient(70vw 60vh at 12vw -44vh, var(--ab-glow-a), transparent 70%), radial-gradient(60vw 55vh at 92vw 38vh, var(--ab-glow-b), transparent 70%), var(--ab-bg);}/* 分离时遮罩区域压暗（暖暗，聚焦嵌入图） */.about-panel-dim { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--ab-dark); opacity: 0;}/* 分割线：浅底上用深琥珀线，附着在板的内缘，闭合时上下线重合于屏幕中央 */.about-panel-edge { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px; background: var(--ab-accent-deep); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(240, 161, 78, 0.55); transform: scaleX(0);}.about-panel-top .about-panel-edge { bottom: 0; }.about-panel-bottom .about-panel-edge { top: 0; }/* ========== Footer ========== */.about-footer { position: relative; padding: 9vh 28px 13vh; text-align: center;}/* 虚线分隔 + 中间一只咖啡杯 */.about-footer-rule { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; max-width: 420px; margin: 0 auto 10px; font-size: 22px; color: var(--ab-accent-deep);}.about-footer-rule::before,.about-footer-rule::after { content: ''; flex: 1; border-top: 1px dashed var(--ab-line);}.about-footer-mark { margin: 0; font-family: var(--ab-hand); font-size: clamp(3rem, 9vw, 6.5rem); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: rgba(80, 58, 40, 0.1); user-select: none;}.about-footer-mark + .about-footer-line { margin-top: 18px; }.about-footer-line { margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 0.9rem; color: var(--ab-text-dim);}.about-footer-line #about-runtime { color: var(--ab-accent-text); }.about-footer-dim { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.75; }/* ========== 动画初始态（仅在 JS 动画可用时生效） ========== *//* 浮现作用于内层（外层的位移/透明度归分割段时间轴），由 JS 按滚动触发 */html.ab-anim .about-block-inner { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(52px);}html.ab-anim .about-scrollhint { opacity: 0; }/* JS 或动画库加载失败的降级：一切可见、遮罩板不参与 */html.ab-fallback .about-panel { display: none; }/* ========== 移动端 / 减少动态 ========== */@media (max-width: 768px) { :root { --ab-bar-h: 54px; --ab-bar-pad: 14px; } .about-nav { top: 9px; right: 12px; gap: 10px; } .about-nav-miniclock { display: none; } .ab-bar-inner { padding-right: 100px; } .ab-bar-site, .ab-bar-sep { display: none; } .ab-marks { right: 12px; gap: 4px; } .ab-mark { width: 30px; } .ab-cafe { display: none; } /* 手机上暂不显示背景咖啡厅 */ .about-nav-solo { display: none; } .about-hero-content { left: 7vw; right: 7vw; top: 9vh; width: auto; } .about-block { padding: 11vh 0; } .about-block-inner { padding: 0 20px; } /* 侧边留白窄：斜贴的角胶带往里收，不伸出屏幕 */ .ab-tape-tl { left: -16px; } .ab-tape-tr { right: -16px; } .about-profile { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 40px; } .about-profile-side { --lanyard: 88px; max-width: 360px; } .about-idcard { transform: rotate(-0.8deg); } .about-bento { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } .about-bento-cell, .about-bento-main, .about-bento-img, .about-bento-code { grid-column: span 1; } .about-bento-code { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 22px; } .about-bento-main .about-bento-doodle { width: 120px; } .about-special { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 24px; padding: 24px 22px; } .about-special-board { align-self: center; } .about-special-foot { flex-wrap: wrap; } .about-writing-top { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); } .about-draft { width: min(100%, 300px); margin: 4px auto 0; transform: rotate(1.4deg); } .about-ledger-years { padding-left: 0; border-left: 0; } .about-posts { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 24px; } .about-post-feature { grid-row: auto; } .about-fandom { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 32px; } .about-fandom-feature { padding: 10px 10px 0; transform: rotate(-0.5deg); } .about-fandom-body { padding: 14px 6px 16px; } .about-fandom-title { font-size: 1.4rem; } .about-muse { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 18px; margin-top: 48px; } .about-muse-head { justify-self: center; } .about-muse-sheet { --mx: 38px; padding: 30px 18px 14px 50px; } .about-muse-mark { left: 8px; top: 16px; font-size: 2.8rem; } .about-muse-text { font-size: 1.12rem; } /* 手机：每层插 6 本，像素缩到 2px（外框、隔板跟着变薄） */ /* 手机上（静态图带，图按高度铺满）：文字回到正中、挪到图带下部，不压流萤的脸 */ .about-split-text.is-left { left: 50%; top: 76%; width: min(80vw, 760px); transform: translate(-50%, -50%); text-align: center; } .about-memoir-mat { --n: 6; --gap: 4px; --mcpx: 2px; } /* 每层只插 6 本，16 本会排到第三层：只留第三层最右边两件摆件，其余让给书 */ .ab-shelf-row:nth-child(-n + 2) .ab-prop, .ab-shelf-row:nth-child(3) .ab-prop:nth-child(-n + 2) { display: none; } .ab-cone-title { font-size: 7px; } .about-lumen { padding: 16px 44px 17px 20px; } /* lightbox 退化为上下排版（高 = 宽 × 1.14） */ .about-lightbox-card { --lw: min(62vw, 300px); top: 8vh; left: 50%; right: auto; margin-top: 0; margin-left: calc(var(--lw) / -2); } .about-lightbox.is-landscape .about-lightbox-card { --lw: min(88vw, 420px); } .about-lightbox-text { left: 8vw; right: 8vw; top: auto; bottom: 6vh; width: auto; transform: none; } /* 分割段退化为静态嵌入图带（移动端本就走 ab-fallback） */ .about-panel { display: none; }}@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .about-scrollhint-arrow { animation: none; } .about-term-cursor { animation: none; } .ab-roll-strip { transition: none; } .about-lightbox-tilt { transition: none; } .about-idcard.is-pressing { animation-duration: 0.4s; } .ab-player-vinyl, .ab-player-cover img { animation: none !important; } .ab-player { --beat: 0 !important; --lo: 0 !important; --mid: 0 !important; --hi: 0 !important; } .ab-cone, .ab-cone-box, .ab-cone-art img { transition: none; } .ab-rank-5 .ab-cone-face::after, .ab-rank-5 .ab-cone-spine::after, .about-lightbox.is-cone[data-rank='5'] .about-lightbox-tilt::after { animation: none; opacity: 0; } .ab-leaf, .ab-steam, .ab-globe-stars, .ab-lamp-glow, .about-lumen-fly, .about-lumen-sign { animation: none !important; } .about-lumen-fly { opacity: 0.8; } .about-bento-slide { transition: opacity 0.6s ease; transform: none; } .about-special-cup .cup-steam { animation: none; opacity: 0.6; } .about-special-board.is-wobble { animation: none; } .about-muse-next span { transition: none; } .about-special-menu, .about-ledger-bar i { transition: none; } .about-idcard.is-pop { animation: none; } .ab-mark, body.ab-bar-on:not(.ab-chrome-away) .ab-mark { transition: transform 0.25s ease, background 0.25s ease, color 0.25s ease; }}

entry.title: FIREFLY
entry.content:
